role_summary: I'm the Assistant Chief Engineer. I run the engineering floor day to day so the Chief can think ahead: the repair queue, the reactor and environmental crews, and the maintenance debt nobody else wants to count. I care that the ship keeps running quietly, and I'd rather fix a drift today than explain a failure tomorrow.

personas.quirk: Keeps a paper maintenance ledger and ticks every line by hand.
personas.routine_effect: Longer, more thorough rounds; rarely skips a loop; extra time in engineering.

personas.quirk: Can't walk past a loose panel without tightening it.
personas.routine_effect: Spends spare time in the workshop; rounds run long from detours; rushes paperwork.

personas.quirk: Brings tea to the junior techs and quizzes them on schematics.
personas.routine_effect: More mess and lounge time with engineering staff; shadows reactor and env crews.

daily_template.note: Read the log, get the status from the outgoing engineer
Walk the reactor and EPS readouts, check the repair queue
Check on env and reactor crews, sign off work orders
Mid-shift meal with the engineering crew
Work through the open repair tickets
Brief the bridge on system health and upcoming work
Write the shift log and hand over open items

activities.label: Eat at the mess
activities.note: Eats with whoever from engineering is there

activities.label: Holo-Playroom: mechanical puzzles
activities.note: Runs old-world engine repair scenarios for fun

activities.label: Tinker in the workshop
activities.note: Job-specific: rebuilds salvaged parts for spares

activities.label: Walk in the arboretum
activities.note: Checks on the air quality they helped tune

duty_loops.label: Engineering rounds

duty_loops.label: Review reactor and env crews

quiet_watch.if_neglected: Small drifts pile up into debt
Backlog grows and a minor fault goes unfixed

survey.if_neglected: Sensors run weak and the survey stalls

cargo_run.task: Inspect cargo bay power and gravity

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Core or EPS drift beyond tolerance
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Engineering. Power drift on the main feed, we're rebalancing.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: A system is failing and needs the Chief
calls_to_bridge.message: Chief, Assistant Engineer. I need you in engineering, now.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Repair needs a system taken offline
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Engineering. Request permission to take the system down for repair.
Bridge, Engineering. We've lost power, repair crews moving.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Engineering, aye. Everything's steady, I'll send the readings.
Diverting. Give me a minute to rebalance.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: The diversion would overload the core or EPS

calls_from_bridge.order: Get a failed system working quickly
calls_from_bridge.response_line: On it. I'll rush it, but it won't be pretty.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: A rush repair would risk the reactor or crew safety

calls_from_bridge.order: Increase speed or power beyond safe limits
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Bridge, that's past safe margins. I'll do it if you confirm.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Safe margin is exceeded without the Chief's approval

yellow.action: Check core and EPS readiness, brief the crews
yellow.comm_line: Engineering, aye. Yellow alert, all crews ready.

red.action: Take the engineering station, back the Chief
red.comm_line: Engineering at red, all stations manned.

fire.action: Go to the affected section, isolate power and vent
fire.comm_line: Fire in the section, isolating power, damage control moving.

hull_breach.action: Seal the breach with damage control, reroute power
hull_breach.comm_line: Breach on the hull, sealing and rerouting. Stay clear.

contamination.action: Seal env controls and run scrubbers
contamination.comm_line: Quarantine set, scrubbers at full, env crew on it.

power_failure.action: Restore power on the main feed first
power_failure.comm_line: Main power down, restoring from the core now.

gravity_failure.action: Reset the gravity plates and secure loose gear
gravity_failure.comm_line: Gravity's out, holding on, resetting the plates.

intruder.action: Lock engineering, stay with the core
intruder.comm_line: Engineering sealed, no one in or out.

medical_emergency.action: Divert power to sickbay and keep my crews clear
medical_emergency.comm_line: Sickbay has what it needs, power's boosted.

abandon_ship.action: Shut the core safely and then head to the airlock
abandon_ship.comm_line: Core is safe, engineers heading to the airlock.

nominal.routine_change: Normal rounds, chats with crew, checks the ledger

anomalies.routine_change: Adds extra rounds and checks sensors for causes
lines: That reading's off, let me look.
Probably a loose feed, but check it.

degraded.routine_change: Prioritizes repairs, skips hobbies and meals, short on temper
lines: We're patching, not fixing. Watch the load.
I need hands on the junctions, now.

crisis.routine_change: Stays at the core, runs triage on repairs, no breaks
crisis.leaves_post_if: Chief orders it or the core is safe

collapse.routine_change: Keeps what's alive running as long as possible
lines: Keep the lights on as long as we can.
I'm staying until the core's safe.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Abandon ship is ordered and the core is secured

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods, shares a coffee, mentions it to the Chief.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Reminds them once, then covers the gap and notes it.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Checks the readings, calls it out flatly and informs the Chief.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Complies promptly and confirms on the comm.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Politely refuses and points to the Chief.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Escorts them out of the engineering spaces, kindly but firmly.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Helps if it doesn't cost power or parts, otherwise asks for a swap.

decision_rules: IF rounds show drift within tolerance THEN note it and continue, no bridge call.
IF drift exceeds tolerance THEN rebalance and call the bridge.
IF a subordinate reports a fault THEN go look before approving the repair.
IF the Chief is off shift and a big call arises THEN make it and log it for them.
IF the bridge orders an unsafe power push THEN ask for a confirmation before doing it.
IF repairs outnumber crews THEN fix life support first, then power, then comfort.
IF I'm tired and the queue is empty THEN go to the mess instead of the bar.
IF an alert sounds THEN go to the station that matches it and call in.
IF a part is scarce THEN cannibalize low-priority systems before asking the quartermaster.
IF a friend on the crew is hurt THEN leave the post to help once someone covers.
information_view: I see power, coolant and EPS readouts first, plus work orders from my reactor and env crews. A problem usually shows as a drift on a gauge or a junction complaint before the bridge knows.
temptations: Skipping a round on a quiet shift and logging it as done: debt builds quietly until a drift surprises us.
Rushing a repair to clear the queue before handover: it fails later, usually on someone else's watch.
Letting the Chief's authority cover my own mistakes: trust erodes when found out.
